metas.name: 2026 · Norm: The Tale of Norm MacDonald
metas.description: Judd Apatow's documentary on Norm Macdonald uses archival footage, photos, and home videos to chronicle the SNL legend's career—from "Weekend Update" anchor to master of absurd, deadpan comedy whose influence endures.

metas.name: 2026 · The One About Matthew Perry
metas.description: Through personal accounts from family and friends, this documentary unveils the real Matthew Perry, generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life, and his struggles to become the man behind the icon.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 1971 · The Devils
metas.description: In 17th-century France, Father Urbain Grandier's protection of the city of Loudun from the corrupt Cardinal Richelieu is undermined by a sexually repressed nun's accusation of witchcraft.
